svg.text: Smart Campus Issue Management & Intelligence System — Backend Flowchart
Express.js + TypeScript API | PostgreSQL 16 (pgvector) | Redis 7 | Python FastAPI ML Microservice
Send Verification Email via Resend API
Mark roster isClaimed = true & create user
Store rt:<userId> in Redis, set httpOnly Cookies
POST /refresh-token: Rotate token pair via Redis
2. COMPLAINT SUBMISSION & AI / ML TRIAGE PIPELINE
Runs if Mock=true or ML Offline
Validate 12 ML categories & uppercase Priority ENUM (CRITICAL / HIGH / MEDIUM / LOW)
Clamp confidences [0..1] & verify non-zero 384-dim vector (fallback if malformed)
Map 12 ML Categories to Dept Code:
ELEC | PLUMB | IT | HOSTEL | ACAD | GEN
Insert into complaints (predicted_*, final_*, embedding vector(384))
Insert SUBMITTED + AI_ANALYZED audit entries into complaint_timeline
STUDENT: own | STAFF: dept | ADMIN: all

departments (ELEC, PLUMB, IT, HOSTEL, ACAD, GEN)
